description: This Java source file defines a utility class LogUtil for logging, specifically providing methods to obtain and enhance Akka logging adapters with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) support, especially for handling correlation IDs in a distributed environment. It includes methods for enriching logs with correlation IDs from Ditto headers, custom fields, and managing MDC entries.

classes.name: LogUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for logging enhancements with MDC support, especially for correlation IDs and custom MDC fields.

classes.name: MdcField
classes.description: Interface representing a key-value pair MDC field that can be added to MDC.

classes.name: ImmutableMdcField
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MdcField, encapsulating name and value of an MDC field.

methods.name: obtain
methods.description: Creates a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for the given Akka Actor, with MDC support enabled.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add correlation ID information from various sources (headers, objects) into the MDC for logging purposes.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomField
methods.description: Adds a custom field into MDC for logging, given a MdcField instance.

methods.name: removeCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlationId MDC entry from the logging context.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID from MDC if present.

methods.name: newMdcField
methods.description: Creates a new immutable MDC field with a specified name and value.
